_description: Maps tickers to their non-standard fiscal year end months. Companies NOT listed here use a standard calendar fiscal year (Dec 31). The agent should use this to correctly assign time_period and period_end_date.
_usage: If a company's fiscal year ends in a month other than December, quarterly boundaries shift accordingly. For example, LULU's FY ends late January, so Q4 covers Nov-Jan, Q3 covers Aug-Oct, etc.

LULU.note: Fiscal year ends late January (retail 52/53-week year). Q4 = Nov-Jan.

BABA.note: Fiscal year ends March 31. Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar.

WMT.note: Fiscal year ends late January (retail 52/53-week year). Q4 = Nov-Jan.

TGT.note: Fiscal year ends late January (retail 52/53-week year). Q4 = Nov-Jan.

COST.note: Fiscal year ends late August (retail 52/53-week year). Q4 = Jun-Aug.

NKE.note: Fiscal year ends late May. Q4 = Mar-May.

ORCL.note: Fiscal year ends May 31. Q4 = Mar-May.

ACN.note: Fiscal year ends August 31. Q4 = Jun-Aug.

FDX.note: Fiscal year ends May 31. Q4 = Mar-May.

ADBE.note: Fiscal year ends late November. Q4 = Sep-Nov.

quarter_mapping_guide.description: For companies with non-standard fiscal years, map the period_end_date month to the correct fiscal quarter using the fiscal year end month.
quarter_mapping_guide.example: BABA FY ends March. Period ending Dec 31 → Q3. Period ending Mar 31 → Q4 (which is also FY end).
